code: public static class Guard { public static bool CanEnterInterview(bool rejected, bool reopenRequested, bool authorized) => !rejected || (reopenRequested && authorized); }
explanation: Removed the direct '!rejected' bypass and replaced it with a rule that only allows entry when not rejected, or when rejected but explicitly reopened with authorization (both reopenRequested and authorized true). Non-rejected states remain unaffected as required.
